title: Node texts for one language (format v0)
description: All human-readable text of a node, for one language. A key is looked up in levels[<level>] first, then in common.

aliases.description: Other phrasings that lead to this node.

symbol.description: LaTeX of the symbol, exactly as written in the equation (e.g. R_\oplus).

meaning.description: What the symbol stands for, in the text's language.

unit.description: Unit or typical value (e.g. 'km', '≈ 398 600 km³/s²'). Omitted for dimensionless terms.

terms.description: Definition of every symbol used in the equations. Required as soon as there is an equation.

text.description: Spoken version, read aloud. Plain words only: no symbols, every term defined in words.

subtitle.description: Displayed version, when it differs from the spoken one. Equations inline between $...$ (LaTeX).

links.description: Explorable terms: a phrase of the displayed text that opens another node. The node must be declared in the scene's links. Not clickable during an autoStart tour.

phrase.description: Exact substring of the displayed text, outside equations.
